instruction.text: Select the leaves on the ginkgo tree.

feedback.end: Ginkgo trees are an ancient species from China. They were brought to Europe by sailors in the 18th century.

instruction.text: Select the fruit of the ginkgo tree.

feedback.end: Ginkgo trees grow a small, orange fruit. The fruit is really stinky!
Coconut palms like to grow near water. They can often be found on tropical beaches.

text: Coconuts change from green to brown as they ripen. The white flesh inside a coconut makes for a tasty snack!

atoms.a: Ginkgo trees could only be found in China until the 18th century.
Coconuts turn from brown to green as they ripen.
